observations: The supported transformation removes the tert-butoxycarbonyl group from the alpha-amino amide, converting C(=O)C(CH3)2NHC(=O)OC(CH3)3 to C(=O)C(CH3)2NH2.
The carbamate N–C(=O) bond is cleaved; the core scaffold and amide carbonyl are retained.
